svg.title: TreeLab one-feature response geometry
svg.desc: Complete alcohol slice and first-row all-feature attainable model-output ranges. Not causal effects or prediction intervals.

g.text: TreeLab / exact slices, not causal effects
Hold every other feature fixed. Partition the stored trees, not a sampled response grid.
66 saved slices / 1,028 segments / first three test rows x 11 features x two frozen models
Domains use fitting-only min/max. Rows 1 and 8 are identical copies: their curves agree.
1. Alcohol slice for the first test row, original CSV row 1 (zero based)
Step joins are visual guides; exact <= boundary inclusion and nextafter witnesses are saved.
2. Attainable outputs on each one-feature slice, first test row
* Selected CART / ensemble segments. Output units are ordinal quality scores treated as numeric.
Common-axis extrema, with concrete witness inputs
Opposite stumps can each attain 10 separately, yet their mean is always 5. Separate maxima mislead.
These ranges are not uncertainty bands, causal effects, plausible-wine guarantees or joint-feature bounds.
Correlated features may create impossible combinations. No model refit and no held-out accuracy claim.
Established ICE-style response analysis / UCI Wine Quality, Cortez et al., CC BY 4.0 / MIT code
